gloss: sanity; one's senses; one's right mind

definitions.gloss: sanity; one's senses; one's right mind
definitions.explanation: A sound, normal state of mind, as opposed to madness, panic, or being dazed or drunk.

examples.japanese: {正気|しょうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
{正気|しょうき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}えない→思える：32713_omoeru⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧だ。
examples.english: That's not something anyone in their right mind would say.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かけられて、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{正気|しょうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}した→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧。
examples.english: Only when cold water was splashed on his face did he finally come to his senses.
